title: Expanding Types of Cases to be Reported for Workplace Accidents
what_it_is: Expanding Types of Cases to be Reported for Workplace Accidents

sections.label: Reporting work injuries and WICA consultation
sections.summary: Singapore is studying requiring reporting of all work injuries causing light duty or medical leave, included in the January WICA public consultation, with details when amendments are finalised in April.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This is in line with the reporting criteria in other developed countries, such as those in the European Union.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We are studying the possibility of making it a requirement to report all work injuries resulting in any instance of light duty or medical leave.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This has been included in the public consultation on amendments to the Work Injury Compensation Act (WICA) which was launched just this year in January.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: It will allow us to have a more comprehensive picture of the extent of work injuries and will help improve the targeting of prevention efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We will share more details when the proposed amendments to WICA are finalised this coming April.

sections.label: Coverage of light duty injuries under WICA
sections.summary: The Minister commits to covering all injuries resulting in light duty medical leave in the new WICA, cannot confirm the UK list, and suggests another Parliamentary Question and MOH study.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: At this moment, what I can commit is that we are looking at all forms of injuries that result in light duty medical leave.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Specific to the list in the UK, I cannot confirm right now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But may I suggest that the Member submits another Parliamentary Question so that we can make a comparison.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: I have not done a comparison for this particular Parliamentary Question but, generally, all work injuries that result in light duty medical leave will be covered in the new WICA, subject to some of the consultation exercises that we are having.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Let us take it up with the Ministry of Health (MOH) to study this.
